svg.title: The regular Ran kernel and preservation of regular inputs
svg.desc: The actual insertion j has continuous right adjoint r. Coherent counits reconstruct the identity and its full proper diagonal kernel. Universal restricted coefficients and continuous spectral integration present the projector parameter p by original ind-connections. A closed filtration by collision layers and spherical orbits has smooth maps to the input bundle stack. Finite localization then proves regularity of the full unbounded integrand; projective direct image and the kernel colimit preserve regular inputs.
svg.text: The regular Ran kernel and preservation of regular inputs
Smooth projective complex curve; connected reductive G; all genera and components.
1. Actual adjoints and coherent counits — CDK.1–CDK.8
C(ψ) = Rep(H)⊗ᴵ ⊗ Dmod(Xᴶ), j(ψ) ⊣ r(ψ).
R = coherent limit of C(ψ) under the actual right-adjoint transitions.
j(ψ)r(ψ) = j(χ)T Tᴿr(χ) → j(χ)r(χ), colim j(ψ)r(ψ) = id(R).
Mapping complexes, adjunction mates and every higher simplex remain in this colimit.
2. Proper diagonal kernels and restricted coefficients — CDK.9–CDK.16
K⁰(ψ) = R(H)⊠ᴵ ⊠ Δ(Xᴶ)_*ω(Xᴶ).
R(R) = colim (j(ψ) ⊗ j(ψ)) K⁰(ψ).
K(A) = (id ⊗ Lᵣ)R(R), p = (id ⊗ Γ!)K(A).
p = colim j(ψ)(id ⊗ i⊗ᴶ)B̄(ψ), B̄(ψ) ∈ Rep(H)⊗ᴵ ⊗ I⊗ᴶ.
3. Finite geometric filtration — CDK.17–CDK.21
Closed base layers: at most b distinct marked points.
Within each configuration: finitely many smooth spherical orbit strata.
Over any smooth affine output chart U: S(γ,U) → Bun(G) is smooth.
Every affine open of S(γ,U) is therefore a chart allowed by the input definition.
The actual Satake coefficient restricts to a bounded regular holonomic complex.
4. Finite localization on the full unbounded integrand — CDK.22–CDK.24
All-chart regular input + bounded regular coefficient ⇒ ind-regular on S.
i_*i!Q → Q → s_*s!Q: finitely many triangles recover the ambient Q.
Projective direct image to U preserves the resulting full ind-regular object.
Bounded connection parameters and proper integration over Xᴶ preserve it too.
5. The actual projector — CDK.25–CDK.29
Π(M) = Φ(p,M), Π(M regular) ⊂ M regular.
The outer kernel colimit and the parameter bars are continuous.
On P¹, one stage has kernel E[2] → C; only the whole colimit reconstructs C.
Γ! selects weight zero in the torus model; a forgetful fibre gives a different operator.
Exact proofs: §§3.239–3.252, CDK.1–CDK.29; Solutions3.DV–3.DX.
Conclusion: preservation of regular inputs over the original complex field.
Regularity of the entire projector image and nilpotent support identification need further arguments.
